# Victory announcement

Text: “MEME WITH APEPE. TRADE WITH BingX.”

Original synthetic voice produced locally using [Piper](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl), with the public [en_US-joe-medium](https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/en/en_US/joe/medium) voice model. Its model card identifies the training dataset as CC0. The game distributes the resulting audio only, not the synthesis engine or model.

Pronunciation input: “Meme with Ah-peh-peh. Trade with Bing X.”
Processing: slightly lowered pitch, bass and presence EQ, short room echo, loudness normalization. No real individual is being impersonated.

The 4-second MP3 is prepared ahead of time and delivered from the same CDN as the game. No player text or audio is sent to a speech service.
